_comment: ElevenLabs Conversational AI 'server tool' (webhook). Add this tool to your agent in the dashboard (Agent → Tools → Add tool → Webhook) or via the API. It calls Stella's deterministic engine so the agent never computes figures itself. Replace YOUR-APP.vercel.app and the secret value.
name: lookup_business
description: Look up a UK business by name (and optional postcode) and return the business-rates relief and grants it can claim, with all monetary figures pre-computed. Call this whenever the caller gives a business name. Read the returned spoken_summary back to the caller; never invent numbers.

business_name.description: The business name exactly as the caller said it.

postcode.description: UK postcode of the premises, if the caller provides one (e.g. 'EC1N 7TE'). Optional.

_response_fields_the_agent_should_use.found: boolean — whether a match was found
_response_fields_the_agent_should_use.spoken_summary: string — read this to the caller
